sloka: ततस्ताः सहिताः सर्वा विहताशा निरुद्यमाः ।परिक्षिप्य समन्तात्तां निद्रावशमुपागताः ।। ५.५८.८२ ।।।।
transliteration: tatastāḥ sahitāḥ sarvā vihatāśā nirudyamāḥ ।parikṣipya samantāttāṁ nidrāvaśamupāgatāḥ ।। 5.58.82 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then all of them gave up hope of their efforts and scattered around her, succumbed to sleep.
